title: ENVY | It Showed Him Everyone Else
description:
He drew every night, until something small opened a green window and showed him his best friend's best day. Every page he gave it, its window grew.

ENVY | It Showed Him Everyone Else is an animated short film about the habit you feed, and the day he stopped feeding it.

Who do you compare yourself to? Tell me in the comments.

#shortfilm #animation #selfimprovement #envy #thedevilyoufeed
